FAQ

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Pick a loader and a version, say what the project should do, and check every file before you use it.

Which loaders and versions are supported?

Paper, Folia, Purpur, Spigot, Bukkit, Sponge, Velocity, BungeeCord, Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge, on Minecraft 1.1 to 26.3.

What if a loader doesn't support my version?

The workspace tells you, and the Why? button explains the reason.

Do I get a .jar?

Yes, when a build service is connected. Without one you get the source code only.

What if a build fails?

The errors go back to the model, which gets up to three tries to fix them.

Is the generated code safe?

Treat it like any plugin or mod you download. Read it and test it on a private server first.
